name: FileBrowser-Quantum
description: A fast web file manager with search, previews and share links.

paths.name: Data
paths.description: FileBrowser's settings (config.yaml), user database, cache and the first admin password (password.txt). Back this folder up.

paths.name: Srv
paths.description: The files FileBrowser shows: all of your MOS /mnt/cache folder. Change this to a smaller folder to share less.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: FileBrowser Quantum web page and WebDAV, published on host as 6738

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: FILEBROWSER_ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: The admin's password. Leave it blank and the app makes a random one on first start; find it in the app's logs, in the box marked CREDENTIALS. Only used when the admin is made; change it later in FileBrowser.
